title: Sarfatti's Navy friend and the living craft on the East Coast

tellings.quote: they couldn't breach the craft. They couldn't get inside the craft because the craft works. It's alive. It's conscious and it's got an attitude that unless you vibrate at the right level, you can't get in the craft.

plain: At a Navy facility on the US East Coast, a recovered craft is said to have resisted every attempt to get inside it, because the craft is alive, conscious, and "got an attitude": unless you "vibrate at the right level," you cannot get in. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron relays this from the physicist Jack Sarfatti, who in turn heard it from a friend in the Navy. If true, it would mean such craft are living things, not just machines.
